answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 20604 Country: United Kingdom Title: my husband has left me and gone back to pakistan ,he hasnt rang me since 3 months please can you do dua for me and tell me a wazifa for him please, his parents dont like me. Question: salam, my husband has left me and gone back to pakistan ,he hasnt rang me since 3 months please can you do dua for me and tell me a wazifa for him please, his parents dont like me. Answer ID: 20604 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 424/349/B=1431) Recite لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله five hundred times with durood 100-100 times before and after regularly for forty days, and supplicate Almighty Allah for the removal of your troubles. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
